lessons.name: right_hand_walk
lessons.title: Right Hand Walk
lessons.instructions: Right hand in C position: thumb on middle C. Walk up to G with fingers 1-2-3-4-5 and back down. Keep every finger resting on its own key.
tips: Curve the fingers; play on the tips.
Say the finger numbers out loud as you play.
Keep the wrist level with the hand.

lessons.name: left_hand_walk
lessons.title: Left Hand Walk
lessons.instructions: Left hand in C position: little finger (5) on the C below middle C, thumb on G. Walk up and back.
tips: The left thumb is still finger 1 — it sits on the highest key of the position.
Let the arm carry the hand; do not press with the wrist.

lessons.name: hands_together_walk
lessons.title: Hands Together Walk
lessons.instructions: Both hands in C position, moving in the same direction. Play it hands separately first (use the hands selector), then together.

lessons.name: skips
lessons.title: Skips and Steps
lessons.instructions: A step moves to the next key, a skip jumps over one. Watch the finger numbers: skips use fingers 1-3, 2-4, 3-5.
